chunks: So as to deny what We have given them. Please yourselves for a time; you will come to know soon.

key_terms.فَتَمَتَّعُوا: so let them enjoy / please yourselves

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about those who deny God's favors and enjoy their worldly life?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ar-Rum, this verse highlights the phenomenon of *istidraj* (gradual divine entrapment), where God grants prolonged worldly success to disbelievers as a test rather than a sign of approval. Shia exegetes often link this to the temporary nature of *faraugh* (ease) granted to the impious, emphasizing that their eventual realization will come too late to alter their fate.
